title: What SubSync asks for, and why

scenes.title: What SubSync asks for, and why
scenes.sub: Reads your accounts. Changes only after a preview and a confirm. Sends a message only when a person presses Send.
scenes.text: SubSync shows agencies and businesses what needs attention in their client accounts. It reads your accounts. It changes something only after a preview and a confirm. And it sends a message only when a person presses Send. Here is why each permission is asked for.
scenes.caption: Reads your accounts. Changes only after you preview and confirm. Sends only when a person presses Send.

scenes.text: This is SubSync. Every number on screen comes from the permissions in this video. The accounts here are made-up examples.
scenes.caption: Example accounts. No real customer data.

scenes.title: 1. Accounts and sign-in

rows.label: Account names, time zones, contact details
Which accounts SubSync is installed on
A key limited to one account at a time (the platform has no read-only way)
People, with tags, source and owner
Deals, pipelines and stages
The conversation list, never the message text
Which calendars exist

scenes.text: One. Accounts and sign-in. Seven permissions are required. We read your account names and time zones, the accounts SubSync is installed on, and your contacts, deals, conversations and calendars. One more gives us a key limited to a single account, because the platform has no read-only way to do that.
scenes.caption: Seven required permissions: we read to show every number against the right account.

scenes.text: We read the account list, so each number sits under the right account.
scenes.caption: We read your accounts to show each number under the right account.

scenes.title: 2. Contacts, tags and notes

rows.label: Tag names, for hot-lead and cold-list rules
Names of your custom fields, never the values
Add a note, a tag or a task result on one contact
Create a missing call queue tag

scenes.text: Two. Contacts, tags and notes. We read tag names and custom field names, never the values. We change a contact only when you press a button and confirm a preview, for example to add a note.
scenes.caption: We read tag names. We change a contact only after you preview and confirm.

scenes.text: Call lists use contacts and tags to rank who to call first.
scenes.caption: We read contacts and tags to build your call lists.

scenes.title: 3. Conversations and messages

rows.label: Who wrote to a lead, and when, a person or an automation. Text is never stored
Send one text or email, only when a person presses Send, after a preview
Delete one junk conversation, after a preview and a typed count

scenes.text: Three. Conversations and messages. We read who wrote to a lead and when, so we can time the first reply. We never store the text. A message is sent only when a person presses Send, and a delete needs a typed count.
scenes.caption: We read who replied and when. A message goes out only when a person presses Send.

scenes.text: Unanswered messages shows who is still waiting for a reply, and for how long.
scenes.caption: We read message times to show who is still waiting.

scenes.title: 4. Appointments and calendars

rows.label: Appointments and their status: showed, no-show, never marked
Calendar groups
Rooms and equipment (for the Account setup check)
Create, change or delete an appointment, after a preview (a delete needs typing)

scenes.text: Four. Appointments and calendars. We read appointments and their status, to find ones nobody marked. We create, change or delete an appointment only after a preview, and a delete needs a typed confirmation.
scenes.caption: We read appointments to find ones nobody marked. Changes need a preview and a confirm.

scenes.text: Appointments lists the ones that need an outcome.
scenes.caption: We read appointment status to show what needs an outcome.

scenes.title: 5. Deals and pipelines

rows.label: Change a deal (stage, status, value, owner) or delete one, after a preview
Create the standard sales pipeline, only when an account has none

scenes.text: Five. Deals and pipelines. The deals themselves are read with the required permission. We change a deal only after a preview, and a delete needs a typed confirmation. One optional permission creates a standard pipeline, only when an account has none.
scenes.caption: We read deals to find stale ones. We change a deal only after a preview and a confirm.

scenes.text: Pipeline and deals shows the money in each step, and the deals that stopped moving.
scenes.caption: We read deals and stages to show stale deals.

scenes.title: 6. Workflows

rows.label: The list of workflows and their state
How many times each ran and how many steps failed
Campaign lists and delivery totals, never who received what
Rename or copy a workflow
Publish or pause
Delete, after typing its name and a saved copy

scenes.text: Six. Workflows. We read the list, run counts and failed steps, and campaign totals, to find ones that broke. We rename, copy, publish, pause or delete a workflow only after a preview and a confirm.
scenes.caption: We read workflow runs to find broken ones. We change one only after a preview and a confirm.

scenes.text: The Workflows page flags failing and idle workflows across all accounts.
scenes.caption: We read workflow runs to show which ones failed or went idle.

scenes.title: 7. Money

rows.label: Payments, repeat payments, invoices
Credit balance of each account
Orders and coupons
Payment provider connected, live or test
Products, prices, collections
Invoice schedules, templates, estimates
Charges apps made

scenes.text: Seven. Money. All read only. We read payments, invoices, orders, coupons, products and prices, to show late invoices and problems in how an account takes money. SubSync cannot charge, refund or send an invoice.
scenes.caption: Money is read only. SubSync cannot charge, refund or send an invoice.

scenes.text: Money checks looks at one account at a time, read live, and stores nothing.
scenes.caption: We read invoices, orders and products to show money problems.

scenes.title: 8. Lead intake

rows.label: Form and survey names and when each was submitted, never the answers
Funnel names, their steps and pages
Redirects and trigger links

scenes.text: Eight. Lead intake. We read the names of forms, surveys and funnels, and when each was submitted, never the answers. We also read funnel pages, redirects and trigger links, to find one with an empty target.
scenes.caption: We read form and funnel names and times, never the answers.

scenes.text: Lead intake warns you when a form stops bringing leads. It reads names and times only, never the answers.
scenes.caption: We read form and funnel names and times, never the answers.

scenes.title: 9. Setup and team

rows.label: Team member names
Custom values, text and email templates
Files and saved email designs, scheduled emails: counts only
Phone numbers (last four digits) and number pools
Custom record types and their counts, open tasks
Save one reply target value, after a preview

scenes.text: Nine. Setup and team. We read team names, templates, files, phone numbers, tasks and custom records, as counts and names. Phone numbers show only the last four digits. One small change saves your reply target, after a preview.
scenes.caption: We read counts and names to show what an account is missing.

scenes.text: Account setup lists what each client account has, and what is still missing.
scenes.caption: We read counts and names to show what is set up and what is missing.

scenes.text: In Settings, Call queues, we change a tag or a value only after you preview it and confirm.
scenes.caption: We change a tag or value only after you preview and confirm.

scenes.title: 10. Plan monitor

rows.label: Which accounts are installed, their plan and trial flag
The last charge made through the platform's billing
Installer details: kept for later, not called today
One plan permission: kept for later, it unlocks no read yet

scenes.text: Ten. Plan monitor. We read which accounts are installed and the last charge, to show each plan, trial days left, and an uninstall. Installer details and one plan permission are kept for later, and nothing uses them today.
scenes.caption: We read plans and charges. Two permissions here are kept for later.

scenes.text: Plan monitor warns you when a trial is about to end, or an account leaves.
scenes.caption: We read plan and install status to warn about trials and uninstalls.

scenes.title: What we do not ask for

rows.label: Adding, changing or removing team members
Reading your clients' own plans and payments (company level only)
Sending invoices. The resend button is switched off

scenes.text: What we do not ask for. We never ask to add or remove team members. We never ask to read your clients' own plans. And SubSync does not send invoices.
scenes.caption: Not requested: users.write, saas/company.read, invoice sending.

scenes.title: Kept for upcoming features

rows.label: Read permissions with no screen yet
Change permissions with no screen yet

scenes.text: Kept for upcoming features. Eighteen permissions have no screen yet. Nothing uses them today, and any future use will show a preview first.
scenes.caption: Kept for upcoming features. Nothing uses these today.

scenes.title: Your data stays yours
scenes.sub: Uninstall SubSync and we delete the keys and the copied data.
scenes.text: When you uninstall SubSync, we delete the keys and the data we copied. Thank you for watching.
scenes.caption: Uninstall SubSync and we delete the keys and the copied data.
